cases.proves_bugs: BUG-205 (the wording half only: the direction question shows the actual levels of each end, IL 10.000 and IL 11.000, instead of two identical Open end -> Open end choices; what the chosen answer then draws is NOT driven)
cases.title: CD with the first level lower than the second warns in the window and asks which direction to keep, naming both levels (also for a level of exactly 0.00); Esc leaves nothing drawn; levels that fall the drawn way ask nothing
cases.plan_item: CD direction (triage group N1; daily cards D01 and D04 neighbour); BUG-205 (wording half), BUG-686 (the question is asked for a level of exactly 0.00)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-205 (expected: the choice shows the actual levels so a drafter can tell the two options apart), BUG-686 (a level of exactly 0.00 must count as a level) and BUG-682 (Cancel in the Uphill box) as written in BUG_CARPARK.md. BUG-682 is NOT claimed: this question is a command-line question, and the "Pipe cancelled and erased" box of that entry was never seen.
cases.expected: CD from 150000,-90000 to 170000,-90000 with levels 10.00 then 11.00: the New Pipe window says the upstream invert is lower than the downstream; Start Pipe closes it and CE asks "Pipe was drawn Open end at point 1 (IL 10.000) ... but the entered levels indicate Open end at point 2 (IL 11.000) ..." with the choices Use level direction, Keep nominated direction and Review; Esc prints "[CE] CD command cancelled." and the drawing holds no new object. The same with the levels 0.00 then 0.50 (the question names IL 0.000 and IL 0.500). With the levels 11.00 then 10.00 no question is asked and the pipe is placed ("Pipe placed."). No CE window is left open and the drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The question, its wording and the Esc ending come from the live New Pipe window and the live CD prompt.
not_automated: The answers to the question (Use level direction, Keep nominated direction, Review) are NOT driven: a case cannot answer a command-line question after a window press. BUG-076, BUG-560, BUG-581, BUG-681, BUG-682 and what an answered question draws are not claimed.
OBSERVED, not judged (words sweep, BUG-377 family): the question prints the arrow as the raw text \U+2192 on the command line. The case records the whole line.
